subject.title: feat(android): add staged Wear status bridge

question: Should OpenClaw officially ship and maintain a Wear OS companion beginning with this phone-proxied status-only slice?
rationale: The PR creates a separately installed first-party app, a versioned cross-device contract, and ongoing signing, publishing, update, and compatibility obligations that require Android product ownership.

options.title: Sponsor staged Wear support
options.body: Approve the phone-owned identity model and require versioning and production release proof before merge.

options.title: Keep Wear experimental
options.body: Allow source-only exploration but do not present or wire it as an officially shipped Android surface yet.

options.title: Defer official Wear support
options.body: Close or pause the PR until the Android owner wants to own the separate watch application and release contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor staged Wear support
recommendation.body: Approve the phone-owned identity model and require versioning and production release proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository policy identifies this person as the Android app maintainer, and the decision directly affects Android product and release ownership.
